Hotels.Name: Grand Hotel Excelsior
Hotels.Description:
The Grand Hotel Excelsior has one of the best settings in the city. It’s a pastel-hued high-rise number located on the seafront, right next to the entrance to Valletta’s time-warp capital. You’ll look out over the glass-like waters of Marsamxett Harbour here, and there’s a sandy beach in front of the resort with a private section for hotel guests.

Luxury comes in spades at this place, from the glittering chandeliers and carpeted stairways of the interior, to the immaculately manicured gardens outside, which give way to a curvy sea-facing swimming pool. Among the hotel’s swish facilities there’s a state-of-the-art spa to recharge in, with candlelit cabins for facials, wraps and massages.

When it comes to dining, you’ve got loads of choice. Head for Spice Island to watch chefs expertly whipping up Caribbean and Asian fare at show cooking stations, or Admiral’s Landing for gourmet Mediterranean flavours. Meanwhile, at the Tiki Grill, you can tuck into cooked-to-perfection steaks and seafood. Three atmospheric bars take care of cocktails, including the stylish Yacht Club, which hosts evening entertainment and does a great line in tapas-style platters outside of mealtimes.

Hotels.Name: LABRANDA Riviera Hotel & Spa
Hotels.Description:
Set on the stunning Marfa Bay, Labranda Riviera Hotel & Spa is a spectacular destination for your next sunny getaway. Escape to the natural splendour that surrounds this charming hotel. Lay back, switch off and forget about your everyday routines.

Bask in the stunning sunshine which blankets the hotel. Take a refreshing dip in one of the three saltwater pools. For the ultimate relaxation experience, spend some time in the hotel’s spa and fitness centre where you can book an indulgent treatment. Perhaps you’d prefer to just use their amenities which include a sauna, steam room and Jacuzzi. For something more active, the hotel has an approved Diving School offering various packages to numerous dive wrecks and sites found in the vicinity.

Home to four restaurants and four bars, you’ll be well looked after here. Begin your day with a buffet-style breakfast, snack throughout the day if you so choose and then choose from the delicious cuisines for dinner which include Asian, Italian, Lebanese, traditional and international. Throughout the day and into the evening, you can unwind with your drink of choice from one of the bars. When you have had enough fun for the day, retreat back to your room for a comfortable night’s sleep. This hotel is sure to provide a fantastic place for you to enjoy a holiday in the sunshine.

Hotels.Name: Topaz Hotel
Hotels.Description:
The Topaz Hotel is a great-value hotel on the outskirts of Bugibba. You’ll find it in a quiet spot that’s still within walking distance of the resort’s centre and the seafront promenade. It’s got everything you could need for a relaxing break in Malta – we’re talking a huge outdoor pool with a section for kids, and an indoor pool that’s heated – perfect for the cooler winter months. You can also play games of snooker and ping pong in the games room, while little ones are busy in the indoor play area.

The main restaurant is set up for buffet meals, and there’s an à la carte restaurant that serves up delicious Italian dishes. For light bites, meanwhile, you can head to the poolside snack bar. During the summer months you can expect evening entertainment, including everything from karaoke to live music.

The room are bright and airy and decorated in a traditional style and each come with a flat screen TV, a safe and a bathroom.
